title: Lindsey Graham Viciously Mocked for Posting Gun Photo After Disney World Photos Go Viral
summary: Sen. Lindsey Graham got caught vacationing at Disney World during a government shutdown while TSA agents worked unpaid. TMZ spotted him at a Mickey Mouse breakfast holding a bubble wand. His explanation—he was meeting Trump officials—didn't land well. The next day, he posted a photo clay shooting with a shotgun, seemingly trying to project a tougher image. Big mistake. The internet immediately roasted him for the obvious overcompensation. Replies flooded in mocking the whiplash from bubble wand to shotgun, with people accusing him of being tone-deaf to furloughed workers. His team's recovery attempt spectacularly backfired.
